about: Terms of art of contract law that keep their legal meaning in Blake's contracts (house rule 13; MSCD 1.57 one word, one meaning; MSCD 1.8-1.13 terms of art). For each: the word forms (term_word, matched in a defined term's name), its legal meaning, what marks the legal sense in a definition (legal_def) and in the contract's text (legal_use), what marks another sense in a defined term's name (name_other) or definition (def_other), ordinary-word uses in another sense (uses_other), and the replacement. only_with_legal_use: report a defined term or an ordinary-word use in the other sense only when the contract also uses the word in its legal sense (for words whose other sense is common and harmless alone). Patterns are case-insensitive unless noted. Each entry's examples must each produce a finding, and its lookalikes none (the lint self-test runs them).

terms.legal_meaning: the transfer of a contract right (Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 317)
terms.replace: Work Order, Task, or Engagement (for staff, designate)
examples:
"Assignment" means each work order that Customer issues under this agreement.

Neither party may assign this agreement.
Customer may issue a written work order (each, a "Work Assignment").
Executive shall perform the duties that the Chief Executive Officer assigns to Executive.
Contractor shall assign 2 engineers to the project.
The Statement of Work assigns responsibility for notifying Customer to the Provider project manager.
lookalikes:
"Assignment" means a transfer of any right under this agreement.

Neither party may assign this agreement.
Customer may issue a written work order (each, a "Work Order").
Neither party may assign this agreement without the other party's consent.

terms.legal_meaning: the transfer of the performance of a duty to another (Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 318)
examples:
"Delegate" means each individual whom Sponsor registers for the Conference.

Neither party may delegate its duties.
lookalikes:
"Attendee" means each individual whom Sponsor registers for the Conference.

Neither party may delegate its duties.

terms.legal_meaning: the bargained-for exchange that makes a promise enforceable (Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 71)
examples: "Consideration" means Lender's review of each Loan Request.
lookalikes: "Merger Consideration" means the cash that Buyer pays for each Share.

terms.legal_meaning: the giving up of a claim or right
terms.replace: Version (or Update); for funds in escrow, release is the usual word and stays
examples:

terms.legal_meaning: a failure to perform a contract obligation (an Event of Default)
terms.replace: Standard Setting (or Preset); for by default, automatically or unless Customer changes it
examples: Provider shall ship the Devices with the default settings that Schedule A lists.  If Customer defaults in paying any invoice, Provider may suspend the Services.
lookalikes: Provider shall ship the Devices with the standard settings that Schedule A lists.  If Customer defaults in paying any invoice, Provider may suspend the Services.

terms.legal_meaning: a right to buy, sell, extend or renew on stated terms (an irrevocable offer)

terms.legal_meaning: an offer to perform, such as tender of delivery or of payment (UCC 2-503)
examples: Contractor shall submit a tender for each Project no later than 10 days after Owner's request.
lookalikes: Seller's tender of delivery is complete when the Goods reach Buyer's dock.  Acme may make a tender offer for the Shares.

terms.legal_meaning: a security interest: property rights that secure an obligation (UCC Article 9)
terms.replace: Security Interest or Collateral for a bare defined Security; for a physical-safety use, a plain word (Access Badge, guard, site staff)
examples: Company issued Employee a building access badge (the "Security Badge").  Employee shall return the Security Badge.  Employee grants Company a security interest in the Bonus.
Borrower grants Lender a security interest in the Equipment (the "Security").  Lender may enforce the Security after an Event of Default.
Owner shall provide security personnel at the Site during each delivery.  Owner grants Supplier a security interest in the Equipment until Owner pays for it.
Company issued Employee a building access badge (the "Security Badge").  Employee shall return the Security Badge when the Term ends.
Owner shall provide security personnel at the Site during each delivery.
